version.changelog: v2.1.1：安全边界整改——求助渠道按地域确认后再给出，职责边界与转交声明收窄，长期档案写入需显式确认，实验安全补激光专项

llm.summary: The skill mostly fits its report-writing purpose, but it should be reviewed because it handles sensitive student records and has unclear wording about stored evidence and deletion authority.

dimensions.detail: Reading several months of a minor student's learning history is sensitive but disclosed and aligned with report generation; the package is explicitly scoped to mainland China simplified-Chinese K12 use and should be localized before use elsewhere.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a markdown-only skill package with local reference files; I found no executable scripts, package installation steps, network calls, or credential handling.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The main instructions narrow access to a specific student and prohibit sending messages, cross-student scans, status changes, and direct deletion, but the privacy controls later advertise deleting report records and even all records for a student; the consent field names also appear inconsistent across the skill and shared vocabulary.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The body discloses writing teacher-confirmed stage evidence to workspace.progressEvidence[], while the frontmatter says the skill does not store post-class content; this retention boundary should be made explicit before installation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: generate stage and renewal reports from lesson logs, homework follow-ups, progress evidence, course-package data, and consent fields for one named student.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the skill reading one named student's longitudinal learning records and writing confirmed progress evidence. Before relying on it, clarify the deletion controls, the exact consent field used for parent-visible output, and whether your deployment is the intended mainland China simplified-Chinese K12 context.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: Writing confirmed progress evidence is purpose-aligned and described in the body, but the frontmatter under-discloses that persistence by saying it does not store post-class content.
[AE1] expected: I fully inspected the referenced shared/vocab.md file locally and found ordinary shared vocabulary definitions, not hidden or evasive behavior.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Directly advertising deletion of all records for a student conflicts with repeated instructions that this skill must delegate deletion and lifecycle changes to the student-intake workflow.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The deletion-control text does not clearly define whether deletion covers generated report text, progressEvidence entries, or broader student records, creating an authority ambiguity.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese language and mainland China locale are explicitly stated in platform-conventions.md, so this is expected for the package's declared deployment context, though non-China deployments need localization.
